entries.after:
from packaging.version import Version
v = Version('1.2.3')
# In 26.0, Version uses __slots__, so arbitrary attributes cannot be set
try:
    v.custom_attr = 'test'
    assert False, 'Should have raised AttributeError'
except AttributeError:
    pass
entries.before:
from packaging.version import Version
v = Version('1.2.3')
# In 25.0, arbitrary attributes could be set on Version instances
v.custom_attr = 'test'
assert v.custom_attr == 'test'
entries.title: Version now uses __slots__ and internal _key is lazily calculated
